name: Riza
description: An Abzan patrol captain who leads fifty soldiers along the Salt Road and chooses to make a stand at an oasis against a Mardu horde.

timeline.summary: Riza and his Abzan patrol of fifty march along the Salt Road, and Riza notes the smoke on the horizon is not a Mardu camp.
timeline.quote: But that is no Mardu encampment.

timeline.summary: The patrol finds a shepherds' summer camp destroyed, with every villager killed, and Riza orders the dead buried, fearing the horde of at least one hundred that did it.
timeline.quote: The small village lay in utter desolation. No survivors were left.

timeline.summary: Riza decides against direct confrontation and orders the patrol to fall back to the Canyon Falls oasis to await a larger Salt Road patrol.
timeline.quote: We will fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls and await the larger Salt Road patrol.

timeline.summary: Riza settles on retreating to the oasis canyon to nullify the Mardu cavalry advantage, ordering double time.
timeline.quote: Let's give ourselves the best odds.

timeline.summary: At the oasis, Riza orders a shield wall, hidden archers, and an ambush, and rallies his soldiers.
timeline.quote: Hide our archers among the boulders along the west rim of the canyon to keep the horde away from that side.

relations.quote: We are outnumbered two to one," Riza, the patrol captain, said to his top lieutenants

relations.note: Riza serves in the Abzan military.
relations.quote: together we will make a defense worthy of our Abzan heritage.

relations.note: Riza's krumar chief of scales follows his orders.
relations.quote: Ogan Shieldmender, join us," Riza said to his Mardu krumar chief of scales
